   120→            // session.idle is deprecated and not reliably emitted in run mode.
   121→            const props = (event as any).properties
   122→            if (props?.status?.type !== "idle") break
   123→            const sessionID = props?.sessionID ?? currentSessionID
   124→            if (!sessionID) break
   125→            // Use sync variant: `opencode run` exits on the same idle event,
   126→            // so an async hook would be killed before completing.
   127→            callHookSync("turn-end", {
   128→              session_id: sessionID,
   129→              model: currentModel ?? "",
   130→            })
   131→            break
   132→          }
   133→
   134→          case "session.compacted": {
   135→            const sessionID = (event as any).properties?.sessionID
   136→            if (!sessionID) break
   137→            await callHook("compaction", {
   138→              session_id: sessionID,
   139→            })
   140→            break
   141→          }
   142→
   143→          case "session.deleted": {
   144→            const session = (event as any).properties?.info
   145→            if (!session?.id) break
   146→            seenUserMessages.clear()
   147→            messageStore.clear()
   148→            currentSessionID = null
   149→            // Use sync variant: session-end may fire during shutdown.
   150→            callHookSync("session-end", {
   151→              session_id: session.id,
   152→            })
   153→            break
   154→          }
   155→
   156→          case "server.instance.disposed": {
   157→            // Fires when OpenCode shuts down (TUI close or `opencode run` exit).
   158→            // session.deleted only fires on explicit user deletion, not on quit,
   159→            // so this is the only reliable way to end sessions on exit.
   160→            if (!currentSessionID) break
   161→            const sessionID = currentSessionID
   162→            seenUserMessages.clear()
   163→            messageStore.clear()
   164→            currentSessionID = null
   165→            // Use sync variant: this is the last event before process exit.
   166→            callHookSync("session-end", {
   167→              session_id: sessionID,
   168→            })
   169→            break
   170→          }
   171→        }
   172→      } catch {
   173→        // Silently ignore — plugin failures must not crash OpenCode
   174→      }
   175→    },
   176→  }
   177→}

    45→// InstallHooks installs Gemini CLI hooks in .gemini/settings.json.

    64→

    67→

    74→		}

    82→				return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hooksConfig in settings.json: %w", err)
    83→			}
    84→		}
    85→	} else {
    86→		rawSettings = make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
    87→	}
    88→
    89→	if rawHooks == nil {
    90→		rawHooks = make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
    91→	}

    94→	// that old Entire versions wrote directly into hooks, which Gemini CLI 0.33+

   106→	} else {
   107→		cmdPrefix = "entire hooks gemini "
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	// Parse only the hook types we need to modify
   111→	var sessionStart, sessionEnd, beforeAgent, afterAgent []GeminiHookMatcher
   112→	var beforeModel, afterModel, beforeToolSelection []GeminiHookMatcher
   113→	var beforeTool, afterTool, preCompress, notification []GeminiHookMatcher

   117→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterAgent", &afterAgent)

   119→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterModel", &afterModel)
   120→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeToolSelection", &beforeToolSelection)
   121→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeTool", &beforeTool)
   122→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterTool", &afterTool)
   123→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "PreCompress", &preCompress)
   124→	parseGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "Notification", &notification)
   125→

   127→	// If the exact same hook command already exists, hooks are already installed.
   128→	// When cleanupDone, we still need to write the file to persist the cleanup,
   129→	// but we return 0 (not 12) so callers know no hooks were added.

   136→			}

   138→			// without running the full remove+add cycle.
   139→			return 0, writeGeminiSettingsFile(rawSettings, rawHooks, hooksConfig, settingsPath)

   145→	sessionEnd = removeEntireHooks(sessionEnd)

   147→	afterAgent = removeEntireHooks(afterAgent)
   148→	beforeModel = removeEntireHooks(beforeModel)
   149→	afterModel = removeEntireHooks(afterModel)

   153→	preCompress = removeEntireHooks(preCompress)

   172→	beforeToolSelection = addGeminiHook(beforeToolSelection, "", "entire-before-tool-selection", cmdPrefix+"before-tool-selection")
   173→
   174→	// Tool hooks (before/after tool execution)
   175→	beforeTool = addGeminiHook(beforeTool, "*", "entire-before-tool", cmdPrefix+"before-tool")
   176→	afterTool = addGeminiHook(afterTool, "*", "entire-after-tool", cmdPrefix+"after-tool")

   178→	// Compression hook (before chat history compression)
   179→	preCompress = addGeminiHook(preCompress, "", "entire-pre-compress", cmdPrefix+"pre-compress")

   181→	// Notification hook (errors, warnings, info)
   182→	notification = addGeminiHook(notification, "", "entire-notification", cmdPrefix+"notification")

   184→	// 12 hooks total:
   185→	// - session-start (1)
   186→	// - session-end exit + logout (2)
   187→	// - before-agent, after-agent (2)
   188→	// - before-model, after-model (2)
   189→	// - before-tool-selection (1)
   190→	// - before-tool, after-tool (2)
   191→	// - pre-compress (1)
   192→	// - notification (1)
   193→	count := 12
   194→
   195→	// Marshal modified hook types back to rawHooks
   196→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "SessionStart", sessionStart)
   197→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "SessionEnd", sessionEnd)
   198→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeAgent", beforeAgent)
   199→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterAgent", afterAgent)
   200→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeModel", beforeModel)
   201→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterModel", afterModel)
   202→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeToolSelection", beforeToolSelection)
   203→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "BeforeTool", beforeTool)
   204→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "AfterTool", afterTool)
   205→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "PreCompress", preCompress)
   206→	marshalGeminiHookType(rawHooks, "Notification", notification)
   207→
   208→	if err := writeGeminiSettingsFile(rawSettings, rawHooks, hooksConfig, settingsPath); err != nil {
   209→		return 0, err
   210→	}
   211→	return count, nil

   214→// stripNonArrayHookFields removes non-array values from rawHooks (e.g., legacy
   215→// "enabled": true that old Entire versions wrote directly into hooks, which
   216→// Gemini CLI 0.33+ rejects because hooks.additionalProperties requires arrays).
   217→// Returns true if any fields were removed.
   218→func stripNonArrayHookFields(ctx context.Context, rawHooks map[string]json.RawMessage) bool {
